clue.text: A top grad working with spin — as this?

definitions.text: A top grad working with spin — as this?

indicators.note: working here means the letters of these words are reworked into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A clever graduate takes up a job in spin-doctoring and wonders what that makes them.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: the letters of A TOP GRAD plus SPIN, 'working', give the answer, and a graduate working in spin would be exactly this.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who spreads slanted information on behalf of a cause, the job of a spin doctor.

clue.text: Ocean state losing name for conciliation

parts.note: the Pacific is the largest ocean

indicators.note: losing means a letter is dropped from the word for state

parts.note: a state is a nation

explanation.surface: A Pacific island nation drops a name as a gesture of reconciliation.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean the act of making peace or calming a dispute; they are synonyms.

clue.text: Willow, oversize, that is over river

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the earlier pieces sit above the next one

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize/oversize
i.e. (id est) means that is
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: An oversized willow tree overhangs a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The osier is a species of willow whose shoots are used in basket-making.

clue.text: Mean to grow old around girl

indicators.note: around means the ageing word is wrapped about the girl's name

parts.note: to age is to grow old
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: It would be cruel to grow old around a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' looks like 'unkind', but here it has its statistical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: An arithmetic mean is the statistical sense of a typical middle value, a synonym.

clue.text: Fruit beers containing odd pieces of pepo

indicators.note: containing means the beers word holds the picked letters inside it

parts.note: ales are beers

indicators.note: odd pieces are the first and third letters of the word pepo

explanation.surface: Fruit beers brewed with bits of pepo, a kind of melon or gourd.
explanation.definitionFit: These are a common orchard fruit, so the answer is an example of the definition.

clue.text: Tricked and abandoned minus millions

indicators.note: minus means a letter is subtracted from the word for abandoned

parts.note: to have dumped something is to have abandoned it
M is the abbreviation for million(s)

explanation.surface: Someone conned and left penniless, short of millions.
explanation.definitionFit: To be fooled or deceived is to be taken in, a synonym.

clue.text: Piano with dirty outside is diminished in value

indicators.note: outside means the dirty word goes around the piano letter

parts.note: soiled means dirty
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A piano with a grubby exterior has lost its resale value.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ruined or marred has lost its worth or quality.

clue.text: Brilliant old Peruvian lineage

parts.note: Incan describes the ancient people of Peru
descent is ancestry or lineage

explanation.surface: A dazzling ancestry traced back to ancient Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing white-hot, hence extremely bright or dazzling.

clue.text: Black Sea peninsula loses area in unlawful act

indicators.note: loses means a letter is shed from the peninsula's name

parts.note: Crimea is the peninsula jutting into the Black Sea

explanation.surface: A news-like line about territory lost in an illegal annexation of Crimea.
explanation.definitionFit: An offence against the law is a synonym phrase for this.

clue.text: Cinema diet is fizzy drink and banal stuff

parts.note: pop is a fizzy soft drink
corn is trite, sentimental material

explanation.surface: A sneer at the junk sold at the movies: fizzy drinks and trash.
explanation.definitionFit: Puffed maize is the classic snack eaten while watching films.

clue.text: Countenance including vase for ashes where body is burned

indicators.note: including means the face word takes the vessel inside it

parts.note: a countenance is a face
an urn holds cremation ashes

explanation.surface: A grim cremation scene: a face, an urn of ashes, a body burning.
explanation.definitionFit: A crematorium uses an enclosed chamber of intense heat to burn bodies.

clue.text: Character of the Niles mouth

definitions.meaning: a letter of the Greek alphabet
the fan-shaped mouth where the river Nile meets the sea

explanation.definitionFit: It is the fourth Greek letter, and the triangular river-mouth shape named after that letter.

clue.text: Officer element

explanation.definitionFit: It is informal slang for a policeman and the name of a reddish metallic element.

clue.text: Playwright Harold entertains circle to offer piece of advice

indicators.note: entertains means the playwright's name takes a guest inside it

parts.note: Harold Pinter was the English playwright
O is circle-shaped

explanation.surface: Harold Pinter hosts a group in order to give them advice.
explanation.definitionFit: A useful hint or tip is a synonym for a helpful suggestion.

clue.text: Out of breath rearranging nearly all of wedding

indicators.note: rearranging means the remaining letters are put in a new order
nearly all of means the last letter of the word wedding is dropped

explanation.surface: Breathless after reorganising almost an entire wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly all of' drops the final G from WEDDING, leaving WEDDIN, which 'rearranging' turns into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Being breathless after exertion, as after a punch to the stomach, is a synonym.

clue.text: One serial broadcast from Tel Aviv, perhaps

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: broadcast means the letters of serial are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A serial drama transmitted from Tel Aviv.
explanation.definitionFit: Tel Aviv is a city in Israel, so someone from there is an example of the nationality.

clue.text: Time to maintain new inn

parts.note: to aver is to maintain or assert

explanation.surface: It's time to keep up the new pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub or public house is a synonym, a place selling drink and lodging.

clue.text: Strove to run ideally every day when beginning

indicators.note: when beginning means the opening letter of each of the five words is taken

explanation.surface: A jogger tried to run every day when first starting out.
explanation.definitionFit: To have attempted or made an effort is a synonym of having striven.

clue.text: Rubbish REM at first occurring during sleep

indicators.note: occurring during means the picked letter sits inside the sleep word

parts.note: doss is British slang for sleep, often rough

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of REM is used

explanation.surface: Dreams in REM sleep are just nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: REM (rapid eye movement) is the dreaming phase of sleep, so the surface reads naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Scum or worthless waste matter is a synonym for trash.

clue.text: Annual return initially brings up unpaid debts

indicators.note: initially means the first letters of Annual and return are taken

parts.note: rears means brings up, as children

explanation.surface: An annual tax return raises the subject of overdue payments.
explanation.definitionFit: Money owed that is overdue for payment, a synonym phrase.

clue.text: Conscious of a watch on dead body

definitions.meaning: alert or alive to something, as in being alive to a danger
a vigil kept over a corpse, read as two words

explanation.surface: Someone aware of a vigil being kept over a corpse.
explanation.definitionFit: Not asleep and alert, a synonym of conscious.

clue.text: Beaten unconscious university lecturer has little energy

parts.note: out means knocked out, unconscious
a don is a university teacher, especially at Oxford or Cambridge
E is the abbreviation for energy, a little bit of the word

explanation.surface: A defeated, knocked-out academic is short of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Surpassed or bettered by someone else, a synonym of defeated.

clue.text: Tell missing head to cheer up

indicators.note: missing head means the first letter of the word for tell is dropped

parts.note: to relate a story is to tell it

explanation.surface: An instruction to tell someone without a leader to cheer up.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone happy or in high spirits, a synonym of to buoy up.

clue.text: Gift men put in it leads to suspicion

parts.note: a present is a gift

indicators.note: put in means the men are placed inside the word it

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gift the men slipped inside leads someone to suspect something.
explanation.definitionFit: A foreboding or intuitive feeling that something will happen, close to a suspicion.
